summary: Mask sensitive Naver top-bar attributes and make stale writer-lock recovery race-safe.
verification: npx vitest run test/unit/agent-auth-store.test.mjs test/unit/agent-naver-topbar.test.mjs test/unit/agent-mcp-client.test.mjs
risks: Sensitive DOM identifiers could be serialized unless every copied token is filtered.
Concurrent lock recovery could remove a live writer lock unless stale-lock removal is atomic.

tasks.title: Filter sensitive top-bar attribute tokens
tasks.change: Mask invalid or sensitive class, id, and data-clk tokens; keep only ARIA roles; reduce href paths to safe segments; add the reported email, session secret, and encoded user path regression case.
tasks.effect: The reproduction values are absent from serialized output while safe tokens and URL origins remain.

verification.risk_reason: The serializer can expose personal data and session secrets to downstream agent context.
verification.test_reason: Current tests do not cover copied identifier secrets or encoded path segments.
verification.subject: top-bar attribute and href sanitization
verification.procedure: Run the requested Vitest command and assert the direct reproduction values are absent.
verification.pass_criterion: All targeted tests pass and none of the reproduction values appear in sanitizer output.

tasks.title: Recover stale locks atomically
tasks.change: Atomically move the stale pathname to a unique temporary name, recheck its inode and dead PID, remove only the verified stale file, and restore a changed live lock only when the original pathname can be claimed without replacement; add an interleaved recoverer regression test.
tasks.effect: A concurrent recoverer cannot unlink another writer's live lock.

verification.risk_reason: Deleting a live lock permits concurrent writes to persistent authentication state.
verification.test_reason: Existing lock tests do not exercise the check-to-unlink race between recoverers.
verification.subject: concurrent stale-lock recovery
verification.procedure: Interleave a second recovery at the first recoverer's atomic lock mutation and verify the second writer's lock remains present and owned.
verification.pass_criterion: The losing recovery fails closed with STATE_UNSAFE and the active writer lock remains intact.
